result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: partial overflow/cutoff of cards in carousel sections that blocks content visibility and creates incomplete information display.

issues.description: The rightmost card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right edge, making delivery details and full restaurant name not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible scroll indicators (arrows or dots) or adjust card sizing to prevent overflow. Consider showing a 'See all' link like in the 'Popular right now' section

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is truncated at the bottom of the screen - restaurant name, delivery time, and other key information are hidden, likely obscured by the bottom navigation bar
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/margin to the content area to prevent overlap with the fixed bottom navigation, or adjust the scrollable content area height to ensure all cards display completely before the navigation bar
